description: Exact price for a group on a date (prices can depend on the season), including chosen extras and the VAT breakdown. Same calculation as the booking page.

guests.description: Number of guests in the group (adults and children together).

options.description: Optional extras, keyed by option id (or option name) from get_tour. Value: the chosen text for a choice, true for a yes/no extra, a number for a quantity.

tour.description: Tour id (the "tour" value from list_tours, e.g. "cosy-tour").

name: get_price
title: Get price
